# MDR wire frames transcribed from the user's own WF-C710N headset (source: probe-log-7-multipoint.txt). Addresses scrubbed.
# Format: one frame per line. '>' host to headset, '<' headset to host, then the full escaped wire frame as hex (3e ... 3c), optional '# comment'.

< 3e 0c 00 00 00 00 04 d7 d1 00 01 b9 3c

< 3e 01 00 00 00 00 00 01 3c
